reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000485 (the melody read from 000485a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells John Stainer as “John H. Steiner”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. John Stainer's dates (1840–1901) are from https://hymnary.org/tune/all_for_jesus_stainer (ALL FOR JESUS / WYCLIFF, 1887, from The Crucifixion, by John Stainer); https://hymnary.org/person/Stainer_John (Stainer, John, 1840-1901). CCEH credits 'John H. Steiner'; no hymn composer of that name is known; CCEH's page gives only the year 1887. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000485a.nwc).
